definitions.gloss: auction; sale by auction; public sale
definitions.explanation: A public sale in which items are sold to the highest bidder. Used for both voluntary auctions and court-ordered forced sales of property.

examples.japanese: {美術品|びじゅつひん}を{競売|きょうばい}にかける。
examples.english: To put artwork up for auction.

examples.japanese: その{土地|とち}は{競売|きょうばい}で{売|う}られた。
examples.english: The land was sold at auction.

examples.japanese: {裁判所|さいばんしょ}の{命令|めいれい}により、{不動産|ふどうさん}が{競売|きょうばい}にかけられることになった。
examples.english: By court order, the real estate was put up for auction.

notes:
{競売|きょうばい} is a public sale where items go to the highest bidder. It covers both voluntary auctions and court-ordered forced sales.

PRONUNCIATION:
- きょうばい: everyday reading
- けいばい: legal/formal reading used in court documents

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {競売|きょうばい}にかける: to put up for auction
- {競売|きょうばい}で{落札|らくさつ}する: to win at auction
- {強制|きょうせい}{競売|きょうばい}: forced sale (court-ordered)
- {競売|きょうばい}{物件|ぶっけん}: auctioned property

SIMILAR WORDS:
- オークション: auction (loanword, used for online and casual contexts)
- {競|せ}り: auction (especially at fish and produce markets)
- {入札|にゅうさつ}: bidding, tendering
